name: graft-robotics
description: Deterministic software pre-flight safety boundary, ROS 2 interceptor, and ISO 10218:2025 / EU 2023/1230 compliance MCP App for physical robots. Includes 19 MCP tools, 7 playbooks, 4 fail-closed form elicitations, 5 live resources, PreToolUse hooks, 6-client Agent Connect, opt-in Fleet Vault status, 6-family Hand HAL, and Rust graft-core spatial verification.
suggestedPrompts: Run /ros2-compliance-audit to generate a ROS 2 pre-flight bundle, verify compliance-pack ZIP, and check Fleet Vault status
Call graft_connect_agent to connect Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, Gemini, Apple MLX, or Gemma 4 to my UR5e cell in L0 OBSERVE
Open the Graft Robotics Workbench side pane, inspect live cell status, and download graft-compliance-pack.zip
Run /remote-shop-onboarding to build a zero-FDE CNC or shop-floor onboarding kit and 48h L0 shadow trial
Graduate my robot safely from Day-1 L1 small-object picks to L2 supervised tasks with operator elicitation
